probability_support: limited, nested calibrator training had as few as two positive cases; output is a cohort-reference estimate, not a validated defect probability

acceptance: Original v2 prototype metrics and support unchanged; report every source separately, cold starts and group uncertainty. This is a public research decision, never local release.
